tools.name: get_pr
tools.description:
Return one pull request selected by its exact id from list_open_prs.

        The result includes the complete stored pull-request record. A title, URL,
        repository name, or unknown id is rejected rather than guessed.

tools.name: post_pr_comment
tools.description:
Post nonempty body text on the existing pr_id from list_open_prs.

        pr_id is the returned id, not a title or an invented name. Markdown is
        stored exactly as supplied. Returns ok=true and the stored comment,
        including its unique id and pr_id. Missing PRs return ok=false.

tools.name: list_open_prs
tools.description:
List identifying pull-request summaries. Defaults to open PRs.

        status may be open, closed, merged, or null for every status. repo and
        author filter by exact repository name and author key. assignee matches
        the assignees list; reviewer matches the reviewers list. These are separate
        relationships. Omitted filters do not restrict results. The summaries omit
        each pull request's body; use get_pr with an exact id to inspect the body.

tools.name: memanto_recall
tools.description: Search the Memanto memory agent by semantic similarity. Use this FIRST before asking the user to repeat information.

pr.title: lantern: fill catalog-sync owner in card config
pr.author: maya
pr.description: The catalog-sync card currently displays `Unknown owner`. This patch adds a static `Product Engineering` owner value to the card configuration so the UI can display an owner immediately.

args.body: Please remove the hard-coded `owner: 'Product Engineering'` fallback. A missing service owner must not be inferred or patched into Lantern’s card config: that would make the card look authoritative without owner-map provenance. Keep the owner unknown/omitted until the catalog-sync ownership record is corrected at the owner-map source with the required provenance, then render from that source.
